description: Per-field, per-baseline, per-period APPROVED corrections for Phase 2B TAX_CFADS_V1 parity. All records manually reviewed and promoted from tax_cfads_v1_proposed.json. Differences matching this ledger → APPROVED_FINANCIAL_CORRECTION. Differences NOT matching → UNEXPLAINED_DRIFT (exit 3).

governance.invalidation_reason: Prior 1934 records were generated from a buggy primary-year implementation that dropped minority-year contributions. Regenerated after fixing engine to remove primary-year ownership logic (blocker 2).

tuho.notes: 517 diffs from single root cause: construction_shl_loss_carryforward. Legacy baseline used prior_tax_loss=25,000 kEUR (no Excel source). Candidate injects 3,568.688 kEUR construction-period SHL interest (tuho_construction_snapshot.json total_shl_idc) via parity adapter, generating construction-period tax loss carried into operations. Opening LCF = ZERO per manual workbook inspection (20260330_TUHO_BP_2.xlsm).

corrections.financial_reason: Phase 2B assigns EBITDA and tax depreciation to calendar years via Dec31-split fragments (half-open interval). Legacy engine uses per-period year_index grouping without a calendar boundary. Amounts shift between periods at the Dec31 boundary, changing per-period taxable income.
corrections.approval_basis: Calendar-year tax axis is the correct approach per the tax model spec. Legacy year_index grouping was a simplification that did not respect calendar-year boundaries for periods crossing Dec31.
